_readme: When the game changed, as far as anyone here can tell.
Clash of Critters publishes no patch identifier that this tool can read,
not in the wiki data, not anywhere the scraper reaches. So a 'patch' here is
an editorial judgement by the maintainer about when the game changed enough
that formations from before and after should not be ranked against each
other. Every entry should carry a `source` so the judgement can be checked
`endsAt` is never written. Each patch ends where the next one begins, and
the newest has no end. That removes the whole class of bug where two
boundaries disagree, and the database has an exclusion constraint that
A formation is filed under the patch whose window contains the moment it
was posted. That is derived, not stored by the client, so correcting a
boundary here and re-running the tool re-files every affected formation
Leaving `patches` empty is a coherent state: the gallery drops the patch
filter entirely and says it is not tracking game updates yet, rather than
inventing a label nobody can check.
